subject: The secret feature 90% of users never find
preview_text: I wasn't going to tell you this, but it's the one thing that changes everything about scanning conversations.
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. When I built this app, I hid the most powerful feature where almost no one would look. I figured if someone found it, they were serious about protecting themselves. Turns out, less than 10% of users ever do.

Here's the truth: scanning one screenshot is like looking at a single puzzle piece. You might see a red flag, but you miss the whole picture. The real danger isn't in one text. It's in the pattern. The slow drip of manipulation. The gaslighting that builds over weeks. The love bombing that fades just enough to keep you hooked.

That's why I built the Pattern Detector. It lives in the 'History' tab. Most people skip right past it. But the users who find it? They're the ones who message me saying 'I finally see it clearly.' It connects the dots across ALL your scans. Shows you the toxicity score trend. Highlights if the manipulation is escalating. It turns your gut feeling into a timeline you can't ignore.

Open the app right now. Tap 'History.' Look for the 'Pattern Analysis' button. Let it show you what you've been missing. P.S. The first user who found this feature told me it saved her from moving in with someone who'd been gaslighting her for 8 months. She saw the pattern, and it finally clicked.
P.P.S. This works best if you've scanned at least 2-3 conversations. If you haven't, scan one now, then come back tomorrow and scan another. The pattern will start to reveal itself.
